verdict.rationale: User approved after 2 revision rounds tightening pty_kill (no signal escalation/pid), spawnPty (onData mirroring runStream, no listenData), and mutation-verifiable tests (clear_if_owner extraction, real portable_pty child kill, dynamic-import bridge test).

Accepted CR-002, CR-003, CR-004, CR-005 (pty_kill wait_timeout_while + ESRCH tolerance, JS listener leak on exit-listen failure). Rejected CR-001 (no run_id guard — out of scope, single active PTY slot by design) and CR-006 (spawnPty exit await has no timeout — pre-existing legacy behavior, must stay unchanged).
Fix-up commit 8becdf5 addresses CR-002/003/004/005 exactly as directed; CR-001/CR-006 correctly left untouched. All tests green.

Browser-based feature verification is structurally impossible for this Tauri desktop app (no Playwright/Cypress config, no HTTP dev server, WKWebView not automatable without tauri-driver, which is absent). All 4 QA gates already passed. User will run the ticket's own manual DoD smoke steps (rebuild + legacy install wizard + Connect Claude Desktop + overlapping-PTY/kill-respawn checks) independently.
